Three high-risk user requirements are not currently verified. I counted a URS as high-risk if at least one HIGH-class risk item assesses or mitigates it. I counted it as verified if a passing test case covers it, either directly or through a linked CS, FS or DS item.

| Requirement | Reason not verified |
|---|---|
| **URS-INC-004** (door-open alarm within 60 s) | TC-OQ-INC-04 failed on incubator INC-03 (TX-0023): the alarm fired at 142 s against a limit of ≤60 s. INC-01, INC-02 and INC-04 passed. There has been no passing re-test. DEV-26-011 is closed, but CAPA-26-012 is still OPEN. CC-26-019 (replace and realign the door switch, then re-run the test) is approved but not implemented. OQ-INC-01 was approved only "with exception" for this item. |
| **URS-EBR-009** (MOI outside 4.0–6.0 TU/cell rejected for GMP runs) | No test case verifies it, directly or through its linked configuration item CS-EBR-03 (MOI range check, hard stop). TC-OQ-EBR-04 only covers the vector volume calculation (URS-EBR-007 and CS-EBR-02). It does not test rejection of out-of-range MOI. |
| **URS-CRF-001** (freezing profile CRF-P01 within ±2 °C with a representative load) | The only test is TC-OQ-CRF-01, run on an empty chamber. There is no loaded test, and no controlled-rate freezer PQ exists. The test passed, but it does not cover the "representative load" condition in the requirement. |

I checked the other high-risk URS items and found each has a passing, reviewed test, directly or through a linked item. These include URS-EBR-001, URS-EMS-011, 012 and 014, URS-LIMS-002 to 004, and URS-ULT-001 and 002. The URS-ULT-001 and URS-ULT-002 test cases passed again after the FRZ-80-02 compressor replacement.

Two items are verified on paper but worth a second look:
- **URS-EMS-014** (alarm escalation by SMS and voice within 15 min): the only test, TC-OQ-EMS-04, ran on 2026-01-20. CC-26-011 later rebuilt the notification groups for a new paging provider, and it stated no re-testing was required. I counted the requirement as verified, but the escalation test predates that change.
- **URS-PRDG-002** (locked program and ≥90% CD3+ purity): TC-OQ-PRDG-02 only tests the program lock and version display. No test covers the purity part.
